transcript: Speaker A: C for cat, D for dog jaisi angrezi toh seekh li, lekin aaj tak English mein dhang se ek sentence tak nahi bol paate ho. Aise toh tumhari koi izzat nahi karega. Isse accha tum aaj ke aaj is app par roz sirf 15 minute English ki practice karke dekho. Phir dekhna kaise farratedar English bolte ho. Is app ko English Seekho app kehte hain. Yahan sirf sikhane wale videos aate hain aur koi ads bhi nahi aate. English Seekho app pe spoken English yaani bolne wali angrezi ka ek show aata hai. Expert chhote-chhote videos mein step-by-step English bolna sikhate hain. Toh bas roz ka 15 minute nikalo, expert ke videos dekho, AI coach se practice karo. Trial sirf ek rupaye ka hai. Phir dekhna kuch hi dino mein tumhari English dekh ke log dang reh jayenge. Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [You learned basic English like C for cat, D for dog, but still cannot speak a single sentence properly. No one will respect you like this. Instead, practice English on this app for 15 minutes daily. See how fluently you will speak. This is the English Seekho app, featuring ad-free learning videos and a spoken English show. Experts teach step-by-step in short videos. Spend 15 minutes daily, watch videos, and practice with an AI coach. The trial is only 1 rupee. Soon, people will be amazed by your English. Click install to download.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho: Speaking App, 15 min, ENGLISH, Basic Level, Medium Level, Advance Level, Spoken English, English AI, INSTALL NOW
summary: The ad leverages social embarrassment over poor English skills to promote the 'English Seekho' app. It highlights features like 15-minute daily lessons, expert videos, and an AI coach, offering a 1-rupee trial with a call to install.
